predicted_fixes: Replace narrative proof with an append-only evidence ledger keyed by subject, oracle family, observable boundary, final-state fingerprint, and reviewer admission state.
Require executable negative, sentinel, error-identity, and lifecycle evidence at the externally observable boundary when those behaviors are changed; source inspection alone cannot close them.
Add a compatibility ledger for added, removed, renamed, rebound, or signature-changed symbols. Completion requires affected-consumer discovery and compilation or an explicit compatibility adapter.

Classify requirement claims as normative, derived, or risk-inferred. Exact literals and removals become blocking only when supported by normative text or a concrete consumer contract, avoiding rounds spent on uncloseable underspecification.

Make authoritative final-state verification dominant over worker probes and reviewer inference, while allowing unavailable verification only when all selected risk oracles have independent admitted evidence.
Introduce bounded objective packets, inspection and command budgets, stable evidence carry-forward, and a reserved gate-output budget to reduce worker and reviewer exhaustion or parse failure.

Allow no-mutation review and finalize contracts to be embedded in the summary and terminal gate record, preventing an otherwise complete patch from consuming another round solely to materialize a process file.
Permit at most one unchanged-fingerprint evidence-closure round and require every continuation to name one falsifiable, worker-closeable next action.
risks: Consumer-compatibility checks may preserve a small adapter when an imported requirement genuinely intends a hard removal.
Boundary-specific counterexamples add focused verification cost for patches with many independent behavioral surfaces.
Default inspection and command budgets may be too small for unusually broad changes; the planner may scale them only with a recorded reason and retained output reserve.
Treating underspecified exact values as bounded risk can miss an unstated external convention when no discoverable consumer or authoritative verifier exposes it.
Embedded no-mutation contracts reduce standalone artifact uniformity; the full reviewer snapshot and fingerprint remain mandatory for traceability.
Older consumers may ignore new ledger fields, so existing manifest keys, Status Delta framing, and terminal markers are retained.
rationale: Repeated false-complete outcomes came from proving code shape while missing observable error, sentinel, ownership, or consumer-compilation behavior. Repeated non-terminal outcomes came from malformed or omitted snapshots, process-only artifacts, uncloseable exact-value assumptions, and oversized reviewer work. The v2 overlay therefore changes the data model and gate inputs: provenance, boundary evidence, compatibility closure, evidence admission, closeable next actions, and final-state authority are explicit schema elements rather than additional prose requirements.
